hooks.$comment: Codex adapter: registers the SAME policy scripts as .claude/settings.json (one implementation, two adapters). Current Codex schema requires this top-level 'hooks' wrapper. HONEST LIMITS: (1) project-local hooks load only for TRUSTED projects, and each command hook must be reviewed & trusted by hash — a new/changed hook is SKIPPED until trusted; (2) some Codex builds need `[features] codex_hooks = true` in .codex/config.toml; (3) on several Codex versions PreToolUse/PostToolUse fire for Bash ONLY, so the Write|Edit matchers below may never run there. Therefore treat these as best-effort guardrails and VERIFY at session start that they actually fire; the guaranteed, agent-agnostic enforcement is the git pre-commit hook (scripts/install-git-hooks.sh). Script logic itself is proven by: bash scripts/test-hooks.sh
